'''Adsalan''' was [[Warder]] to [[Doesine Alwain]].

== Appearance ==
He was keen-eyed with ruddy hair and a square jaw.

== Activities ==
He was standing guard for the [[Black Ajah]] hunters in the [[White Tower]] basement when [[Egwene al'Vere]] and [[Meidani]] arrive.{{ref/book|12|12}}

It can be safely assumed that Adsalan died in the [[Last Battle]], most likely shortly after Doesine's death upon the [[Field of Merrilor]].{{ref/book|14|37}}
